trial_court: Family Court No.2, Kamrup at Guwahati (FC(Civil) Case No. 497/2021)
case_name: Anamika Hazarika vs Manosh Kumar Das
facts_of_case: Petitioner wife is seeking transfer of a divorce case from the trial court to this court under Section 24 of CPC.

legal_principles.principle: The court's jurisdiction is determined by the place where the parties last resided together.
legal_principles.held: In view of the above, under Section 19 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, prima-facie it appears that the Principal Judge, Family Court No. 2 at Kamrup has jurisdiction to entertain this petition.

legal_principles.principle: The burden of proof lies with the party seeking to transfer a case.
legal_principles.held: It is stated that the petitioner wife is presently residing at Bongaigaon and during the sustenance of the marriage, they last resided at Bongaigaon and the marriage had taken place at Bongaigaon.

outcome.final_order: Further proceeding in FC(Civil) Case No. 497/2021 pending in the Court of the learned Principal Judge, Family Court No.2, Kamrup at Guwahati shall remain stayed.
